history_summary.value: The Polverara is an old crested breed named for a town in the Padova countryside, described in Italian writing as far back as the 1500s and possibly related to the Padovana breed. It declined through the twentieth century, dropping to just seven birds, before recovery efforts starting in the 1980s and official Italian recognition in 1996.
